strongs_1890.strongs_def: properly, to keep in; hence, to measure; figuratively, to maintain (in various senses)
strongs_1890.kjv_def: (be able to, can) abide, bear, comprehend, contain, feed, forbearing, guide, hold(-ing in), nourish(-er), be present, make provision, receive, sustain, provide sustenance (victuals).
